The ADDITIONS inverse-coherence check (qa/journey_visual_sweep.py) excludes prop FOOTPRINT but tests the standing-SILHOUETTE band lifted up-screen, so tall/mid authored props (hearth, bar counter, door frame) self-flag on the walkable cells up-screen of their footprint. Raw footprint-exclusion flagged 5-6 authored-structure cells on v1; the correct silhouette-aware discriminator is per-prop OCCLUSION exclusion (runbook §2's footprint-vs-occlusion distinction). NOTE the manifest's wall_run OCCLUSION hulls blanket all 120 cells (the §2 'long run -> huge hull' anti-pattern), so full-occlusion exclusion is vacuous; exclude NON-WALL furniture occlusion only.
